notes.title: 3.12.2023 - Post-release hotfix
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

In this hotfix, I have fixed a few bugs that I found after the game was released, or that were reported to me directly. Also did small improvements to the environment and in game text.

Thank you everyone for your support!

XenOxygen

notes.title: Lair of Anubis is now released!
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for the support during the development of this game.

If you find any bugs, please report them to me directly or post them in the Lair of Anubis community forum and they will be fixed in the next patch!

I hope you enjoy my second game!

notes.title: Lair of Anubis - Final Release date
notes.content:
The game "Lair of Anubis" will finally be out on November 30, 2023, and there won't be any more delays. I'm sorry for the wait, but as a solo developer, recently I was really busy and was unable to work hard on the game.

Thank you for your patience and support

XenOxygen
